title: Debugging shapes and gradients
outcome: By the end, I can explain debugging shapes and gradients using a traced example and a stated limitation.
scenario: Catch a gradient -order bug before the optimiser changes parameters.
given: Toy y=2a+3c, target 4, start [a, c]=[1, 0]. Loss (y-4)². Program claims gradient [-12,-8] in order [a, c].
All inputs and outcomes in this worked example are invented classroom data; no real model run is claimed.

steps.label: Check coordinates
steps.detail: Step 0.1: a losses 3.24, 4.84 give -8; c losses 2.89, 5.29 give -12.

explanation: Array shape and coordinate meaning both matter. A vector with two entries can have the right length but assign each derivative to the wrong parameter. Label the entries a and c, then perturb one coordinate at a time to check their slopes. Repairing the coordinate mapping is necessary before using the gradient to update the network.

counterfactual.change: The program changes its declared order to [c, a] and returns [-12,-8].
counterfactual.prediction: That vector now matches the declared coordinate order.
counterfactual.reason: Gradient values are meaningful only when their parameter names and array positions agree.

student_task: What should a debugging record pair with every gradient value? Point to the relevant step in the picture, then write the changed result and the rule or evidence that supports it.
teacher_answer: Parameter name and index, expected shape, analytic derivative and numerical check; correct [a, c] gradient is [-8,-12]. Changed-case check: That vector now matches the declared coordinate order. Gradient values are meaningful only when their parameter names and array positions agree.
project_evidence: For your Image-pattern Network Investigation, save the input, procedure, observed result and limitation of this check. Label this worked example as practice; use a different, previously unreviewed case when checking independent understanding.
limits: A correct gradient at one point does not establish every batch, shape or activation path is implemented correctly.
